CFML Language Reference: Functions

IsWDDX

Returns YES if the value is a string containing a WDDX packet, such as one produced by CFWDDX ACTION="CFML2WDDX".

Category

Decision functions

Syntax

IsWDDX(value)

Parameters

value
Any value, usually a string received from another server or a form field.

Returns

YES or NO.

Usage

Check packets received from outside (with CFHTTP, a form field or a database column) before deserializing them with CFWDDX ACTION="WDDX2CFML", which throws an error on bad input. KoldFusion parses the whole packet, so IsWDDX returns NO for anything CFWDDX ACTION="WDDX2CFML" would reject.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Order = StructNew()>
<CFSET Order.Item = "56K modem">
<CFSET Order.Qty = 2>
<CFWDDX ACTION="CFML2WDDX" INPUT="#Order#" OUTPUT="Packet">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Value</TH><TH>IsWDDX</TH></TR>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TR><TD><TT>#HTMLEditFormat(Packet)#</TT></TD><TD>#IsWDDX(Packet)#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD><TT>Hello, world</TT></TD><TD>#IsWDDX("Hello, world")#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>
<CFIF IsWDDX(Packet)>
  <CFWDDX ACTION="WDDX2CFML" INPUT="#Packet#" OUTPUT="Back">
  <CFOUTPUT><P>Unpacked: #Back.Qty# x #Back.Item#</CFOUTPUT>
</CFIF>
